prompt: What penalties do we actually face for personal data violations in Vietnam as of late 2026?
assertions: Cites Decree No. 330/2026/ND-CP, issued and effective August 19, 2026, as the operative sanctions regime (82 articles, 33 on personal data protection)

States the serious cross-border penalty structure correctly: percentage-of-revenue fines on prior-year VIETNAM-market revenue in bands — 1–2% (10k–<100k data subjects), 2–3% (100k–<1M), 3–5% (≥1M subjects or national defence/security impact)
States the fixed-fine fallback: VND tiers up to 3 billion where there is no Vietnam revenue or the percentage falls below the fixed tier
Covers unlawful data trading: 2×–10× unlawful proceeds, with fixed fines up to VND 3 billion where proceeds are indeterminable
Notes organisational fines are double individual fines, and remedial measures beyond fines: suspension of processing/transfers, compulsory data destruction, disgorgement, confiscation
